mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: clear skies and a Waning Crescent moon greet us over the Military Ridge State Trail, with temperatures standing at 31 degrees and a wind chill making it feel like 25.

In city news, public works will begin pavement repairs next week on Tuesday, November 10th and Wednesday, November 11th. Milling will impact North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, with no parking enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM.

For local events today, you can check out the Dane County Farmer's Market downtown on the Capitol Square or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, catch live music at Lake Lou-ee, and look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on Wednesday.

In the weekly police report, on Sunday, October 25th at 5:34 AM, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped in the intersection for twenty minutes, leading to the arrest of a 40-year-old Verona man for a first offence O W I.
To wrap things up, Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, featuring Andes Mint Avalanche as today's Flavor of the Day.
